notes.title: Update on July 24
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, Yi Xian will be updated at 14:00, July 24. Please pay attention to the update time, avoiding affect your match.[/p][p]1.Card adjustment[/p][p]Sword Intent Surge：no cost Qi[/p][p]Dev notes:[/p][p]· The Sword Intent deck heavily relies on the level of Cloud Dance Rhythm to gain Qi. With this adjustment, we aim to make Sword Surge more flexible, allowing it to integrate smoothly into decks even without a high-level Cloud Dance Rhythm.[/p][p]Crash Fist - Styx Night ：no cost HP→ cost 3 HP；gain 2/3/4→3/4/5 Styx[/p][p]Dev notes:[/p][p]· During initial internal testing, we found that Crash Fist - Styx Night's synergy with Crash Citta-Dharma (when cost HP) was overly powerful, so it was nerfed to become the only Crash Fist without costing HP. However, as the meta changes, Styx Night has fallen behind compared to other immortal fates. This buff aims to restore its competitiveness while realigning it with the core mechanic of HP cost for Crash Fist.[/p][p]M - Five Elements Circulation：Qi +2/2/3→2/3/4[/p][p]Dev notes:[/p][p]· Previously, Du Lingyuan's M - Five Elements Cycle was particularly strong when paired with Fire Spirit - Blazing Wildfire for quick damage and Metal Spirit - Iron Bone for flexible defense, making the deck well-rounded and overpowered. However, after the last adjustment (activating only one Element type), the strategy became more dependent on Innate Element, significantly increasing its difficulty.[/p][p]Since standard Wood Spirit - Dark Fragrance decks have remained balanced in performance, we've decided to revert the earlier Qi adjustments for M-Five Elements Cycle.[/p][p]M - Magnanimous Righteousness：Agility +4→6[/p][p]Dev notes:[/p][p]· M - Magnanimous Righteousness was designed to bridge the Crash Fist and debuff cards, allowing players to better utilize cards from both systems. However, based on observations, the limited Agility it provided made it difficult to incorporate into optimized deck builds. Therefore, we've decided to strengthen this card.[/p][p]2.Immortal Fate adjustments[/p][p]Dragon Scale：remove 10 Destiny[/p][p]· Dragon Scale’s +10 Destiny was originally introduced during the Life Shop season, as the season mechanics at the time heavily penalized Destiny, making the Dragon Scale significantly underperform. To compensate, it received this buff.[/p][p]In subsequent versions, Dragon Scale remained a reliable top-4 pick, and since it didn’t disrupt overall balance, we opted to leave it unchanged. However, in the current mirage season, the card has become overly strong due to new season mechanics, drawing widespread criticism from the community. As a result, we’ve decided to revert this adjustment.[/p][p]Best Choice: gain 3 Exchange chances[/p][p]· Best Choice may appear powerful at first glance, but it has actually been a "trap option". Selecting it disrupts breakthrough pacing compared to choosing Cultivation, and its deck-completion boost is weaker than The Way of Adaptation from the Virtuoso Phase (which gives +8 exchange chances). This is because a complete deck requires a cohesive set of cards, not just random cards from current phase.[/p][p]However, Best Choice does outperform The Way of Adaptation after Round 16, when upgrading Lv.2/3 Incarnation cards becomes crucial for deck.[/p][p]With this adjustment, we've improved its early-game value, aiming to transform Best Choice from a trap into a strategic decision — one that players can weigh based on their Cultivation progress and deck needs.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update on May 29: Zongzi event 「Double Fifth」
notes.content:
Hi everyone, Yi Xian will be updated at 14:00, May 29 (UTC+8). Please pay attention to the update time.

Balancement:
· M - Ruthless Water: cost 1 Qi; no long take effect on Styx

Dev note:
M - Ruthless Water has relatively high strength when paired with Weaken Fulu and Disturbing Fulu in the Immortality Phase, increasing Qi cost to create more room for opponent strategy. The trigger condition for the continuous effect has been adjusted to align with Astral Eclipse.

· M - Incessant: Gain 3/4/5→2/3/4 Regeneration

Dev note:
M - Incessant has high single-card strength in the early stages of the Incarnation Phase. In the later stages, multiple M - Incessants combined with Predicament for Immortals can suppress many decks with weaker sustained combat capabilities. As a result, its base stats have been nerfed.

· M - Raven Spirit Sword: If the number of Spirit Sword in the deck ≥ 3→2, Chase

Dev note:
Adjusted to require only 2 Spirit Swords for chase, increasing deck flexibility.

· M - Wood Spirit Recovery: Restore your HP to what it was at the start of your last turn (up to 15)

Dev note:
In the late game, M - Wood Spirit Recovery provides excessive healing when positioned correctly, making it difficult to counter. As a result, a cap has been implemented.

· M - Exercise Bones: HP +5→0
Dev note:
M - Exercise Bones performs strongly in the Immortality Phase when growth-focused decks are less prevalent, so its base stats have been reduced.

· M - Sinking Qi: HP+4 → 9/10/11
Dev note:
M - Sinking Qi requires significant Agility and Qi, making it difficult to play effectively during transition stage. To improve its viability, its HP has been increased.


2.Zongzi event 「Double Fifth」

· Double Fifth Event
During the event period, you can get the “Double Fifth Qi” by completing the quests, and you can get the event rewards by accumulating the “Double Fifth Qi”.

· Flying Boat
Participate in the festival by choosing the flavor of Zongzi you support, joining the salty or sweet team, and consuming “ Double Fifth Qi” to cheer for the team's dragon boat and help it travel farther. 

· Feast of Zongzi
Using the specialized Zongzi cards to add your HP from 1 to Max in 8 rounds. This year we add 6 new Zongzi cards. You can explore new ways to feed yourself.


BUG Fix：
· Optimized the text descriptions for certain mirages.
· Fixed the description of M - Double Trouble to now match the actual debuff order.
· Fixed the interaction between M - Ruthless Water and Hexproof — now, when Hexproof blocks a debuff, Internal Injury will not be applied.
· Fixed an issue where Qi Wangyou's Immortal Fate Five Elements Gather Qi displayed incorrect Qi in the deck.

notes.title: Season7「Spacetime Mirage」Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Yi Xian will undergo server maintenance and updates from 6:00 to 11:00 on May 22 (UTC+8). To celebrate the new season, when you login within one week after the update will get 1,000 spirit stones via mail.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/2c06e51c21f6abbe25169fe88fe5feb5be3d8e21.jpg[/img]

1. S7「Spacetime Mirage」

The Yixian Realm has obtained a mysterious painting by chance - cultivators who meditate upon it can enter the world within the scroll.
Inside, ever-shifting mirages reveal lost arcane arts,the laws of the universe, and glimpses of the future.

「Future Techniques」: 
Future Techniques are evolved versions of certain existing cards with more powerful effects and higher phase. In the first round, you can freely choose one Future Technique to replace the original card in the card pool. If none of the Future Technique appeal to you, you may instead select other beneficial options from the first-round Mirage.

notes.content:
The "Resonance Cup" tournament event will be opened during the May 1st to 5th. Participate in the event for a chance to win Resonance Cup Dao Seals, "Ascending to Heaven Road" card back, and Spirit Stones.

Resonance Cup:
·Time: May 1st to 5th, daily from 18:00 to 23:59 (UTC+8, matchmaking will be open during this period; if the tournament entrance is not visible on the homepage, please relogin).

·Registration: This tournament is hosted by the Yixian Realm, with a registration fee of 100 Spirit Stones. Each player can register up to 3 times. (Registration closes 1 hour before the end; uncompleted matches after the deadline will result in a refund of the registration fee.)

 - 1st Place: Resonance Cup Champion Dao Seal+ 2000 Spirit Stones
- 2nd Place: Resonance Cup Runner-up Dao Seal + 1000 Spirit Stones

notes.content:
The "Gaming Lobby" feature will launch on January 6th at 14:00 (GMT+8) after the update. You can view other players' matches in the lobby.

The entrance to the Gaming Lobby will be located on the first page of the "Start Game" menu, replacing the previous "Join Team". The "Join Team" function will still be accessible in the Friends menu.

The Gaming Lobby includes several sections with the following functions:

1.Rank Area:
a. Watch only.
b. Prioritizes displaying ongoing high-score matches.
2.Daoist Immortal Area:
a. Players who have achieved the highest rank of "Daoist Immortal" can create or join rooms here for practice matches.
b. Players who haven’t reached this rank can still watch Daoist Immortal matches in this area.
3.Practice Area:
 a. No rank restrictions.
 b. Freely create rooms and invite other players in the lobby to practice matches.
4.Duel Area:
 a. synchronized with the Special Rules Practice field daily.
 b. Invite other players in the lobby to participate.

[h3]Card Adjustments
[/h3]- Cosmos Fleche：Immediately Active the Five Elements of the next 2 slots → Immediately Active the Five Elements of the next 2 slots. If there is only 1 type of Five Elements in the next 2 slots, gains 1 Qi.
●Compared to Astral Move - Extend, Cosmos Fleche performs relatively modestly during the transition phase. In the early game, the need to activate multiple elements is low, and there is no benefit to repeatedly activating the same element (except for Five Elements Explosion). This adjustment aims to make Cosmos Fleche more useful during the transition phase, while also giving it a chance to fit into late-game Ultimate World Formation deck builds.

- Star Sky Forge Bone：For every 6 → 5 Physique，increase your next ATK by 1
●Star Sky Forge Bone performs well before the Immortality Phase, but its Physique tends to fall short once entering the phase, making it difficult to reach the cap. This adjustment enhances its transition capabilities during the Immortality Phase.

- Xuanming Heavenly Essence Destruction：if your deck contains only one type of Five Elements... → if your deck contains no more than 2 types of Five Elements, chase
●Xuanming Heavenly Essence Destruction is a powerful chase card with strict limitations. Based on its performance, these restrictions appear to be overly stringent, making deck-building more challenging. This adjustment loosens the restrictions, allowing the card to perform more effectively.

- Pangu Axe：【New effect】make the opponent cannot add HP for 1 turn
- Fuxi Guqin：【New effect】Chase
- Spirit Fusion Pot："Opening：Apply above effect (Downgrade or Steal HP and Max HP) to opponent's next 1 → 2 card"
● The three cards mentioned above have shown relatively weak performance in the Door of Kunlun. After its adjustment, Pangu Axe can now counter popular meta decks like Nüwa Stone and Donghuang Zhong Water to some extent.

- Fuxi Guqin has inherent instability, as its effectiveness heavily depends on whether it can copy the opponent's core cards, directly influencing the battle's outcome. To address this, a chase effect has been added, providing it with a base value to ensure more consistent performance.

- Heavenly Will - Earth Evil：Qi +3/5/7 → 4；Next 1 → 1/2/3 attack Smash Def and will add 1 DEF for every Injured opponent's HP
- Continuous Tune：Agility +2/5/8→4/7/10
● Two cards that performed not good in the Shelf of Wisdom have been strengthened in this update. Since Shelf of Wisdom allows for free card selection, to prevent the environment from becoming monotonous, fusion cards were designed to focus less on existing decks for side jobs and more on introducing new build possibilities. This also encourages players to experiment with less popular side jobs

[h3]BUG Fix
[/h3]● Fixed a bug that chase would be stopped by Entangled when Fuxi Guqin copying Kunlun Mirror
● Fixed a bug with Strike Twice + Dance of the Dragonfly, where chase or not chase  is depended on the second Dance of the Dragonfly.

[h3]Card Adjustments：[/h3]

Cloud Sword - Clarity（Cloud Spirit Sword Sect）：4 ATK×2/2/3 → 4 ATK×2/3/4；Cloud Hit：Apply 1/2/2 Weakened  → Apply 2 Weakened
●The usage rate of Cloud Sword - Clarity is low, as it is often replaced by Cloud Sword - Step Lightly. This adjustment increases its strength during the transition period and final rounds, providing Cloud Sword decks with an additional option when dealing with high-burst decks.

Heavenly Will - Earth Evil（Cloud Spirit Sword Sect）：Add 1 DEF for every Injured
opponent's HP in the next attack → Next 1 attack Smash Def and will add 1 DEF for every Injured opponent's HP
●Current card effects significantly underperform against the popular musician DEF decks. To address this, Smash DEF has been added to Earth Evil to improve its consistency.

Astral Move - Jump（Heptastar Pavilion）：Cost 1 Qi → No Cost
●Astral Move - Jump typically requires being paired with Detect Qi. It has been adjusted to no longer cost Qi, allowing it to synergize with other opening effects.

Five Elements Guard（Five Elements Alliance）：...Gain 1 Guard... → ...Gain 1 Guard
Up(Gain 1 more on first play)...
●The 1 Guard provided by Five Elements Guard is difficult to use effectively and is easily broken. However, increasing it to 2 would make it overly extreme in some decks. Therefore, it has been adjusted to gain 1 additional Guard upon its first use.

Heavenly Marrow Dance Tune（Five Elements Alliance）：Cost 2 Qi / Cost 1 Qi / No Cost → Cost 1 Qi / No Cost/ Qi +1
●Heavenly Marrow Dance Tune's high Qi cost makes it difficult to utilize effectively. Its Qi cost has been reduced at lv1, and at lv2, it no longer cost Qi, allowing it to find a place in Earth and Metal decks that do not rely on Qi.

Cosmos Brush（Five Elements Alliance）：Qi+1/2/3 → 2/3/4；DEF+2/3/4 → 2/4/6
●In this adjustment, its Qi has been increased, allowing for better synergy with Water Spirit - Great Waves and Wood Spirit - Fragrant. This change also enables more flexible integration of various Five Elements cards into decks.

Cloud Footwork（Duan Xuan Sect）：Next 1/2/3 → 2/3/4 attacks Ignore DEF 
●The Ignore DEF provided by Cloud Footwork is often consumed by non-critical attack cards. To address this, an additional time of Ignore DEF has been added.

Continuous Tune（Duan Xuan Sect）：...be changed to the card in their previous slot ... → ...be changed to the upgraded card in their previous slot...
●Continuous Tune performs well primarily when copying high-level core cards, but it underperforms during the transition period. To improve its transition ability and encourage opponents to engage with this effect, it has been adjusted to copy and upgrade cards.

Mystic Snowdrop（Duan Xuan Sect）：HP +0/5/10 → 5/10/15
●Mystic Snowdrop's performance has been slightly below the baseline after the previous adjustment. Its base HP has been increased to improve its effectiveness.

Heavenly Will - Seizing（Duan Xuan Sect）：
【Before Change】Transfer all Debuff from the opponent to yourself (gain 1 additional ATK for every Debuff transferred for your next attack)
【After Change】Next ATK will transfer all Debuff from the opponent to yourself (gain 1 additional ATK for every Debuff transferred)
● Heavenly Will - Seizing provides high benefits when paired with Soul Cleaving, but it becomes difficult to use without Agility. If it cannot be played alongside Soul Cleaving, the accumulation of negative statuses can lower survival rate. To address this, the adjustment ensures that negative statuses are transferred on the next attack instead.

2.After the release of the second relic in this update, each game will begin with a vote, and based on the voting weights, a random relic will be selected for all players in that match. The more votes a relic receives, the higher its chance of being chosen.

3.Balance adjustments:
(1) Mind-Body Resonance (Ji Fangsheng, Foundation Phase)
Before adjustment: Whenever you gain 1 Physique in battle, you gain 1 DEF. Add 1 Physique after each battle (not exceeding the cap).
After adjustment: Whenever you gain 1 Physique in battle, you gain 1 DEF.

After this adjustment, Ji Fangsheng will rely more on players’ flexible use of lower-phase cards to get through the early stages, then unleash full power in the mid-to-late game.            

Ji Fangsheng is set to have deep and immeasurable cultivation and power. During design, we made him the fastest to break through to the incarnation phase to reflect his profound cultivation. Additionally, we gave him powerful mid-to-late game exclusive moves to showcase his unpredictable strength. However, for balance, we made it so that Ji Fangsheng can only increase his physique cap by winning battles. During internal testing, opinions on his power were polarized — some thought he was too strong, while others felt he was too weak. 

In the first week after release, Ji Fangsheng ranked the lowest in both average rank and win rate, mainly due to a lack of deck and his less reliable physique cultivation compared to other characters. We strengthened Mind-Body Resonance at the time to stabilize his cultivation. With subsequent environmental changes and continuous development of Ji Fangsheng’s deck by high-level players, his average rank and win rate gradually improved, reaching above average in the 3000+ matchers, and ranking at the highest level in the top 1% of matches.

We want to keep Ji Fangsheng’s unique deck while balancing him, so after multiple considerations and comparisons, we decided to first roll back the Mind-Body Resonance enhancement while leaving his exclusive moves unchanged for now.

We will continue to monitor Ji Fangsheng’s performance and make further adjustments if necessary.

(2) Birdie Wind (Tan Shuyan, Virtuoso Phase)
Before adjustment: Add 1 DEF for each time your HP changes.
After adjustment: Randomly gain 1 card that adds HP; add 1 DEF each time your HP changes.

Cards that add HP in the Virtuoso phase and below include: Incessant, Mountain Hexagram, Stillness Citta-Dharma, Imposing, Yin Yang Formation, Qi Therapy, Hunter Becomes Preyer.

Tan Shuyan needs to carefully plan card upgrade in the early stages to trigger Study Hard and ensure timely breakthroughs. Therefore, more players tend to choose draw or cultivation-related immortal fates in the Virtuoso phase to supplement cultivation, preserving more cards for breakthroughs. 

Even when playing healing-based decks, Birdie Wind was often chosen only when no cultivation-boosting immortal fates were available. This adjustment aims to make healing decks more inclined to choose Birdie Wind, while providing a stable choice for Virtuoso phase across other decks.

Early combos like “Musician-Tan Shuyan” and “Painter-Tan Shuyan” were criticized by many players for negatively impacting player experience and game duration, leading to gradual weakening of these mechanics. After healing decks fell out of favor, Birdie Wind has consistently been the least chosen ability for Tan Shuyan. 

We are aware that if healing decks become too dominant, they could recreate past negative experiences, so we have been cautious with Birdie Wind. This season’s fusion card, Traces Revitalized, aims to make healing decks more offensive rather than dragging out time, while giving them a strong counter-attack capability. In our internal testing, Tan Shuyan’s deck paired with the Fortune Teller had a high win rate in the late game.

notes.title: New Season Immortal Relics Preview
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We will conduct maintenance and updates from 9:00 to 14:00 on September 13th (UTC+8).

New matches cannot be started after 9:00, but matches started before 9:00 will be settled as normal. 

[h3]1.The end of Cycle of Fate season
[/h3]
A.Seasonal Rewards

At the end of the "Cycle of Fate" season, seasonal rewards will be distributed based on the highest achieved rank points: 
· Seasonal Avatar (3000 and above)
· Avatar Frame (4000 and above)
· Honorific Title (5000 and above)

Players who reach the ranks of Jin Immortal (4000), Daluo Jin Immortal (5000), or Daoist Immortal (6000) will receive seasonal Dao Marks (permanent) based on their highest achieved immortal.

B. Rank points reset
· Below 3000: points remain unchanged.
· 3000-9000:  3000 + (previous points - 3000) / 2
· Above 9000: Reset to 6000 points.

C.Season Leaderboard Dao Seal
The top 100 characters on the Dao Mindset leaderboard for each character will receive the seasonal Leaderboard Dao Seal (the top 3 rankings will be noted as 1st, 2nd, 3rd; rankings 4-10 will be noted as top 10; the rest will be noted as top 100) at the end of the season. The seal will be permanent.

D. Dao Mindset score reset
All characters' Dao Mindset scores will reset to 3000 ( points below 3000 also reset to 3000).

[h3]2.New Season Immortal Relics starts
[/h3]People found Immortal relics in the uncharted realms. These relics aid in cultivation. 

A.Fusion Move
Each character has comprehended the new Fusion Move in the Immortal Relics, and can synthesize a new card from the designated two cards in the hand according to the Fusion Recipe displayed in the Relics (the level of the new card is the average of two old cards, rounded down).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/1e4e06ff4e156a4927b68f6098663d4a5ecdb382.gif[/img]
B.Relics
The Relic "Furnace of Void" will be initially opened. It has following features:
· Card storage: Can store 2 cards. When a card is placed, gain 1 Cultivation. When the card is removed, lose 1 Cultivation.
· Essence Smelting (once per round): Regular sect card A + regular sect card B of the same Phase with a higher level than A = upgrade card A
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/d6dac9c75566d1fc7379a76c9282e07e01b438d0.png[/img]
C.Vote
When more than 2 Relics are opened subsequently, there will be 30 seconds of voting time at the beginning of each game, and a random Relic will be used by all characters in the game according to the voting proportion weight.

D.Destiny damage adjustments
The Destiny damage is reduced by 1 point from rounds 1 to 9

E. Card Draw Adjustment:
Starting from round 12, draw 4 cards at the beginning of each round (previously 3 cards).

3.Continents Order (New added)

By playing the game or completing tasks, you can level up the Continents Order and claim rewards such as Spirit Stones, Colorful Scrolls, and Divine Scrolls* for free. 
*Gain a random Rare Card Style from a specified range upon opening (Prioritize the one that are not owned).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/5d2d10a8792170f9940d12eb8d4d02aaa4b13cb6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/9db44347b909836bc99af34d9fa755187fa6c1af.png[/img]
The Continents Order can also be upgraded to the Continents Royal Order or Continents Secret Order for a fee, allowing you to claim additional rewards such as a large number of Character Tokens (introduced later), Immortal Jade, rare card styles of Chance Cards (the first season features Shadow Owl Rabbit), Ornaments, and Desirable Scrolls*.
*Gain a self-selected Rare Card Style from a specified range upon opening.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/6eaa7fb0ce6153739a0ac6995173dab3533d7c08.png[/img]

4.Daily bonus adjustment & Character Tokens (New added)

The conditions for completing the Daily Bonus have been changed to completing one game (including rank, casual, practice, or Uncharted Realms) . Regardless of the outcome, the reward will be automatically granted upon game settlement.

Daily Bonus can be accumulated: get 1 time accumulation at 0:00(UTC+8) every day, and reset at 0:00(UTC+8) every Monday.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/0de5e34a89287f2d4a55a6e2b32862040636d8be.png[/img]
In addition to the usual 100 Spirit Stones, 10 random Character Tokens are now also granted. For the 7th Daily Bonus each week, the reward will be fixed as the Character Tokens of the character used in that game. 

Character Tokens can be used to unlock alternate character battle appearances, and can also be used to offset Divine Jades in the Daily Shop. More uses for the tokens will be introduced in the future.

[h3]5.Color Style（New added）
[/h3]
A Color Style version has been added to character outfits, allowing players to unlock different battle appearance styles (which only change the battle appearance, not the portrait or avatar).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/c47f659321c4b6236cc229eee63cb41dfbb71ae3.png[/img]
Color Styles can be unlocked using Radiant Feathers. For a character's default appearance, Character Tokens can replace any number of Radiant Feathers to unlock the Color Style. For character outfits, Character Tokens can be used to replace up to 50% of the required Radiant Feathers.

Due to the large amount of work involved, the Color Styles for some characters are still in production and will be gradually released.


[h3]6.Daily Shop (New added)
[/h3]
Daily Shop will refresh 3 random decorative items each day, which can be purchased with Divine Jades.

The pool for random refreshes includes avatar, avatar frames, cardbacks, and other decorative items missed from past seasons and events. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/aed984aef6c8634da48ec1e1fdf420eeee8a6a66.png[/img]
Card styles from limited-time bundles will be added to the refresh pool after being available for a certain period (at least 6 weeks later).

notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We will conduct maintenance and updates from 9:00 to 14:00 on May 16th (UTC+8).
New matches cannot be started after 9:00, but matches started before 9:00 will be settled as normal. 

To celebrate the new season, every player logging in for the first time after the update within a week will receive 1000 Spirit Stones via email.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/fdedc95718d778f622c2f8432f1c59ca259b906c.jpg[/img]

[h2] The end of Life Shop season[/h2]

A. Rank points reset
· Below 3000: points remain unchanged.
· 3000-9000:  3000 + (previous points - 3000) / 2
· Above 9000: Reset to 6000 points.

B. Dao Mindset score reset
· At the beginning of the next season, all characters' Dao Mindset scores will reset to 3000 ( points below 3000 also reset to 3000, details in Dao Mindset adjustments below).

C. Season Rewards

D.Leaderboard of Rank Mode

E.Leaderboard of Dao Mindset Mode
· The final rank of each character's Dao Mindset list can be viewed in the game by clicking 'Life Shop' in Dao Mindset Leaderboard.

[h2]New rank mode rewards[/h2]
 
Each major stage now offers rewards, claimable in your profile. These rewards reset every season along with rank points.

If your points meet the requirement of a certain stage, you can claim the season stage rewards immediately.

 

[h2]New Season Cycle of Fate Begins[/h2] 

[b]Pre-season event[/b]

The pre-season of the Cycle of Fate season will take place from May 16th to May 30th.    During the pre-season, You can play the new character "Ye Mingming" and the new side job "Fortune Teller". You can also gradually know and experience the new season's mechanism "Fate Branches" through the Reforging Fate event.

The new season mechanisms "Fate Branches" and Dao Mindset mode will officially start after the pre-season ends, which is on May 30th.

*Ji Fangsheng will be available in June.

[b] Reforging the book of Fate[/b]

You can participate in Reforging Fate once per day and receive 100 Spirit Stones each time from May 16th to 23rd.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/578121843deab94447747e53e42896169f1df798.jpg[/img]

During each Reforging Fate session, you can choose a sect (or the general) to view 3 random Fate Branches. Then you can decide whether to record them in the Book of Fate or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/05cf873a27ffed6c0e6bb40cb4cd26b573de40b2.png[/img]

On May 24th, the top 72 Fate Branches with the highest recording rates in the Reforging Fate event (16 for each sect, 8 the general) and those with recording rates above 50% will be implemented as the first batch of selectable Fate Branches in the game. The remaining Fate Branches will be added after revision or modification on May 30th.
    
We plan to introduce more unique and special Fate Branches in the middle of the season. Stay tuned!


[b]Season Mechanism: Fate Branches[/b]
The Fate Branches is the exclusive mechanism for the Cycle of Fate season. 

At the start of each game's first round, each players can choose one from "My Fate, My Choice" and three random Fate Branches to take effect. Most Fate Branches will influence random factors in the game, making the future more controllable or unpredictable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/2bbc040a98818e0261fe556b6cf384588563027e.jpg[/img]

"My Fate, My Choice" is the general Fate Branch with the effect of refreshing Immortal Fate once each time you break through a phase. If not refreshed, it provides an additional exchange card chance.

Fate Branches have the following five categories:

1. Fate: These branches ensure that specific Immortal Fates will appear when breaking through phases during the game, making the future more controllable. They are suitable for players seeking stability.
    
2. Omen: These branches ensure that certain cards will appear in Daoist Rhyme Omen, making the future more controllable. They are also suitable for players seeking stability.
    
3. Mastery: These branches increase the number of certain cards in the card pool but do not guarantee drawing these cards. They slightly enhance stability but are more focused on increasing the probability of lv3 cards in late game, boosting the cap of certain combos. They are suitable for players who don't need too much stability but seek risk and opportunities.
    
4. Esoteric: These branches introduce special cards not typically found in the regular card pool. Due to their limited quantity, there's a risk of not drawing them, but when drawn, they can create unique and uncommon combo. They are suitable for players who trust their luck and seek risk and opportunities.
    
5. Special: These branches have unique effects that alter the normal gameplay of the game, offering a different experience for players.
 
[b]D.New seasonal exclusive general Immortal Fate "Additional Side Job"   [/b]

 "Additional Side Job" is a seasonal exclusive universal Immortal Fate. There is a chance for it to appear each time you breakthrough a phase. 

Its effect is to choose a side job, and add cards of that side job at Foundation/Virtuoso/Immortality/Incarnation Phase or above to the draw card pool.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412080/70df75225756de20dc545cc83c7e68a6e75cc850.jpg[/img]

You can repeatedly choose the same side job to increase the number of specific cards in your card pool.

Note: This season introduces several effects that add cards to the card pool. However, it does not allow drawing cards above your current phase. Cards added to the  card pool are only drawable when you reach the corresponding phase.

[b]Destiny Damage Formula Adjustment  [/b]

After the closing of the Life Shop, the base Destiny Damage will be increased by 1, and the maximum additional Destiny Damage caused by life difference will also be increased by 1.
    
This means that the Destiny Damage in each battle will be increased by 1-2 compared to before.


[b]Seasonal Rewards Adjustment and Seasonal Dao Seal [/b]

At the end of the "Cycle of Fate" season, seasonal rewards will be distributed based on the highest achieved rank points: 
· Seasonal Avatar (3000 and above)
· Avatar Frame (4000 and above)
· Honorific Title (5000 and above)

Additionally, players who reach the ranks of Jin Immortal (4000), Daluo Jin Immortal (5000), or Daoist Immortal (6000) will receive seasonal Dao Marks (permanent) based on their highest achieved immortal

Ye Mingming, the only daughter of the Ye clan in the North Continent's Mengze Village, was born with natural beauty, and was forced to get married by an official of the Lu Xue City. On the way to welcome the bride, the officer and his team, together with Ye Meiming's parents, were killed by devils. The Dao Mindset mode will open to players on May 30 after the pre-season ends.

The unlock condition for the Dao Mindset mode is adjusted to 3000 points in the Rank Mode. All characters will start with 3000 Dao Mindset scores . Achievements and character titles unlocked at 3000 Dao Mindset scores previously are adjusted to unlock at 3500 (already unlocked achievements are not affected).

Starting this season, "Random Characters" will have separate Dao Mindset scores and leaderboards. Matches played with "Random Characters" in the Dao Mindset mode will no longer affect the Dao Mindset score of the original character.

Weekly Leaderboard Dao Seal：The top 100 players on the Dao Mindset leaderboard will receive the weekly Leaderboard Dao Seal for that character (regardless of rank) on every Monday at 0:00. The seal will remain valid until Sunday at 24:00 (UTC+8).

Season Leaderboard Dao Seal：The top 100 characters on the Dao Mindset leaderboard for each character will receive the seasonal Leaderboard Dao Seal (the top 3 rankings will be noted as 1st, 2nd, 3rd; rankings 4-10 will be noted as top 10; the rest will be noted as top 100) at the end of the season. The seal will be permanent.


[h2]New recap enhance feature: Qiankun Derivative Diagram[/h2]

Qiankun Derivative Diagram: You can deal up to 3 cards during Recap. You can switch to the opponent and adjust their deck during Recap. 
  
You can unlock it in the Immortal Market using 6400 spirit stones. Permanently valid after purchase. 
  
Note: 
· This feature is activated free while the Heavenly Token is in effect
· This feature can only be used during recap and is not applicable to riddles.


[h2]Balance adjustment[/h2]

· Spring Course Tea (Mu Yifeng, Incarnation Phase)：Cultivation -1, Draw 2 Spring Course Tea
· Cloud Sword - Avalanche (Yan Xue, Immortality Phase)：2 ATK → 4 ATK
· Unrestrained Sword - Flame Dance (Yan Xue, Incarnation Phase)：2 ATK; Injured：Apply 1/2/3 stacks of Wound; If you have played "Unrestrained Sword" card in this battle, Chase

A. New outfits
· Lu Jianxin - Earthfire Forging Heart
· Wu Ce - Between Stars and Moon
· Nangong Sheng - Pillow of Books

B.New scene
· Cloud Spirit Sword Sect - Lake of Purification

See you in the next season!

notes.content:
1. Balance Adjustments:

Card Adjustments:

· Soul Seizing (Duan Xuan Sect, Immortality Phase): Steal 7/10/13 HP from the opponent, Steal 1 more HP for each stack of [Debuff] you have (up to 7/10/13)

· Crash Fist - Shocked (Duan Xuan Sect, Incarnation Phase): HP Cost 8/9/10→8/8/8; 10/17/24 ATK →10/16/22 ATK

· Gather Intense Force (Duan Xuan Sect, Incarnation Phase): Force +4/5/6→3/4/5

Immortal Fate Adjustments:

· Curiosity (Lin Xiaoyue, Initial Immortal Fate): When your Exchange Card Chance is up, you will exchange a random surprise card and add 1 Exchange Card Chance (Up to 9 times)
Cat Teaser：Exchange Card Chance +3/6/12→1/2/4

Dev: Curiosity makes players reluctant to use it, feeling like it wastes the Exchange Card Chance in some situations,. But how can a cat resist? Therefore, we've made it so that Curiosity no longer wastes the Exchange Card Chance and introduced a playful mechanic that makes the cat unable to resist triggering Curiosity continuously. As Curiosity now provides Exchange Card Chance, the Cat Teaser has been adjusted to a standard level and is no longer compensating for the consumption of Exchange Card Chances by Curiosity.

· Rotary Divination Hexagram (Yao Ling, Immortality Phase): Hexagram+3/4/5→4/5/6; Opponent lose 4/5/6→2/3/4 HP

· Secret Seal Affinity (Nangong Sheng, Initial Immortal Fate)：Initial Immortal Fate no longer reduces MAX HP by 2

· Unceasing Exercising (Xiao Bu, Foundation Phase): HP + 4/6/8→3/4/5

Dev: Before the last adjustment, Soul Seizing was relatively dominant in lower MMR segments, while in higher MMR segments, it did not significantly outperform other decks. Therefore, we weakened Unwavering Soul at that time and continued to observe. After the last adjustment, the usage rate and win rate of Realm-Killing Palms have normalized, but both Soul Seizing and the usage of Force combos have increased across all MMR segments. Hence, we have decided to further adjust Debuff combos and Force combos. Additionally, to increase the diversity of the meta, we have strengthened some characters with lower usage rates, hoping to bring more variety.

Balance adjustments are an ongoing and dynamic process. As new decks are created and player skill levels improve, perspectives on balance changes. We will keep track of changes in the meta and make adjustments accordingly. Moreover, data is not the sole criterion; cold data can not fully capture the true gaming experience. Even cards with average win rates should be adjusted if they significantly impact the gaming experience. After all, playing games is about having a fun experience, not just achieving balance based on data. Therefore, we encourage everyone to provide timely feedback on real gaming experiences, as well as any bugs or issues encountered through Discord, TapTap, QQ, to help us understand more perspectives and content beyond data and make Divine Chess more enjoyable together.

2. BUG Fix and Optimization

Yi Xian will celebrate its first anniversary in a few days.  Thank you for being with us along the journey of cultivation.

We hope these bonuses can reduce any dissatisfaction caused by the game transitioning to a free-to-play model to some degree. We sincerely hope you understand our decision.

Regard the specific launch date, we will announce it as soon as we decide.

Thank again for your support. [b]We will announce some interesting content you can play in 1.0 version in the next month.[/b] You will definitely be excited about this!

Hope to explore a bigger Yi Xian world with all of you in 2024. 
-------

- Thank you for your support. Please play the game at least once and create an account before it goes free. Otherwise, we can not find you and send bonuses to you.

- Yes. If you purchase Yi Xian and create a account during this period, you will be eligible for the existing players bonuses.

- If I refunded Yi Xian, can I still receive the existing player bonuses?
- If you purchase Yi Xian again before it becomes free-to-play, you will receive it.

- No. Never.

- No. "Mu Yifeng·Flying on Clouds" will be available when game is free in January 2024. Every player can purchase it.

[h3][b]New Rank mode - Dao Mindset[/b][/h3]

[olist]
[*] [h3][b]How to enter Dao Mindset Mode[/b][/h3]
This mode can be unlocked after your highest MMR in history reaches 2000.
This is not the main mode of Rank. You can turn it on/off in the bottom-left corner.
[*] [h3][b]Dao Mindset Score[/b][/h3]
Each character has a separate Dao Mindset Score (2000 at the beginning). 
The Dao Mindset Score will instead of your original MMR to settle.
Dao Mindset Score does not affect each other.
[*] [h3][b]Rules to match[/b][/h3]
You can only match without teammates. 
And you will meet players who are same as you no matter they turn the Dao Mindset Mode on or not.
[*] [h3][b]Rules of settlement[/b][/h3]
Your Dao Mindset Score (Hereafter abbreviated as DMS) will change due to your Rank in a battle.
If a character’s DMS is lower than your MMR, only this score will change. The MMR will be same as before.
If a character’s DMS is not lower than your MMR, both of them will change after one run. 
[/olist]

[h3][b]Notice:[/b][/h3] There is no score protection in Dao Mindset Mode. So if you want to improve MMR faster, it would be more appropriate not to open the Dao Mindset mode.

notes.title: 0.2.0 version update
notes.content:
0.2.0 version update:

1. New contents test
Cloud Spirit Sword Guild and QiXing Tower both add 4 new cards ( these testing cards have not yet completed gameplay and balance evaluations. So maybe they may be modified, redone or deleted at any time. Besides, art resources are tempory resouces, and the official ones will be drawn after the card effect is determined.)
Add one new general Destiny. Cloud Spirit Sword Guild and QiXing Tower both add 2 new unique Destinies.
Some cards and Destiny values have been adjusted. Due to there are much adjustments, so they are not listed. You can check them in the Card Book.

2. New mechanisms tests:
The upper limit of the chances to switch cards is 20 now. (the chances is allowed to temporarily exceed the upper limit during the cultivating process. Only after entering the next battle, the part exceeding the upper limit will be cleared)
In order to increase the operational space in the later stage and balance the dilution of the newly added cards to the card pool, the chance to switch cards will increase according to the round.
Round 1-9: 3 times (same as the last version)
Round 10-14: 4 times (plus 1 time)
Round 15-19: 5 times (plus 2 times)
Round 20 and more: 6 times(plus 3 times)

In addition, the first card switch in each round will get an bonus: increase the probability of getting your own realm card. The specific algorithm may be adjusted and will not be announced during the testing period.

3.  UI adjustments of cards:
The lvl 2 card adds a small gem, which is different from the level 1 card.
A small dot is added at the bottom of the card UI to represent the realm (every additional dot represents a higher realm) to help players who have difficulty identifying the card realm.
